result.quote: after the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the old prophet who had brought him back saddled the donkey for him.
result.reason: The action is correct, but the wording implies that the old prophet had eaten; the verse says the man of God finished eating and drinking. Also, “for him” does not establish that it was the man’s own donkey. Revise to: “What does the old prophet do after the man of God finishes eating and drinking?” Answer: “He saddles the donkey for him.”
